name: go9_se_best
hypothesis: SE+GlobalPool architecture achieved best loss (1.389 at 200 iters), still improving. Extending to 500 iters with all proven improvements should push further. scale500 plateaued at iter 125 with plain CNN — SE architecture may avoid this plateau.
success_criteria: Loss below 1.35 (beating se_globalpool's 1.389). If loss plateaus for 100+ iters above 1.35, kill.
notes: Combines proven SE+6blocks architecture with pruning=0.03, VLW=0.5, BS=256. All individually validated. Run AFTER kitchen_sink finishes or is killed.
